title: RAW instrument configuration and overlapping site do not collapse distinct operations
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_NOT_EXECUTED. Albertus describes longitudinal villi serving attraction and transverse villi serving compression/retention in overlapping organs. A shared instrument kind needs explicitly scoped configuration and event role; no orientation-only causal law or target meanings follow.

design.source_specific_content: The attraction account describes lengthwise villi in the stomach and certain intestines whose motion brings food to digestion. Retention additionally uses transverse villi in the stomach and intestines, pressing food so it stays in place in more perfect animals.
design.source_locus: Complete chapter, current reader lines 25 and 28-30; retained within the full attraction/retention discussion at 25-30.
design.question: Can a shared instrument-kind expression acquire a written spatial configuration and instrumental role without silently changing its lexical identity or making its organ determine its action?
design.unknown_after_source: No target expression for instrument kind, direction, organ, pressing, motion or retention is available from this task. It is unknown whether a written reusable configuration construction or independently named instruments best represents any admitted passage.

proposed_content_schema.CONFIGURE: CONFIGURE(instrument_kind, spatial_configuration, site, bodily_owner) returns an instrument description. Same kind or site does not equate two described instruments, owners or episodes.
proposed_content_schema.INSTRUMENTAL_ROLE: INSTRUMENTAL_ROLE(instrument_description, operation_description, material_participant) preserves the instrument kind, configuration, site and owner while attaching its stated role in the operation.
proposed_content_schema.operation_result: A written transport account directs the stated food toward the digestion place; a written pressing/holding account prevents its displacement during the stated retention. No result is inferred from the geometric descriptor alone.
proposed_content_schema.scope: The animal scope and the narrower qualification on transverse retention instruments must remain explicit. No villi, orientation or animal instrument is transferred to plants or to every nutritive bearer.
proposed_content_schema.identity_limit: Longitudinal and transverse descriptions are configurations of one instrument kind, not assertions that one physical instrument turns itself and reverses action. The source is generic; any shared actual body, portion or event needs written binding.
proposed_content_schema.causal_limit: This is an account of configured instrumental roles, not a controlled intervention proving that rotating villi alone changes function. No geometric angle, pressure, speed or necessary-and-sufficient mechanics is supplied.

connected_cases.input: An explicitly animal-scoped instrument description: villi, lengthwise configuration, stomach or a stated intestinal site
connected_cases.next_relation: A motion/attraction role connects those instruments with food brought toward the digestion place.
connected_cases.constraint: Instrument configuration and operation are separate written arguments. A shared organ name cannot itself mean both the transport event and its instrument.

connected_cases.input: A retention-instrument description within the source's qualified animal scope: villi, transverse configuration, stomach or intestinal site
connected_cases.next_relation: A compression/retention role connects those instruments with food remaining at the stated place.
connected_cases.constraint: The overlapping site and shared instrument kind are compatible with a different operation. They do not permit reusing a transport-only event denotation without explicit additional content.

rivals.name: Independent functional instrument names
rivals.contract: Name attractive villi and retentive villi separately and state their locations.
rivals.consequence: This can preserve every source fact. Only a complete written shared-kind plus configuration construction could favor compositional reuse; the source alone cannot choose the vocabulary.

rivals.name: Organ fixes operation
rivals.contract: A stomach/intestine label determines a single faculty or operation whenever it appears.
rivals.consequence: It cannot preserve the described overlap of sites with distinct instrument arrangements and roles unless it introduces a separate role/configuration expression.

rivals.name: Orientation is a reversible motor operator
rivals.contract: Switching one instrument from longitudinal to transverse by itself converts attraction into its exact inverse.
rivals.consequence: The source supplies no such intervention or inverse. Transport and holding are distinct operations, not automatically reversible mappings of one food state.

costs.unbound: Every target term, direction reference, bearer, instrument/site ownership, participant and complete operation/result assertion; schemas do not automatically correspond to morphemes or tokens.

design.known_overlap: IDEA000567 already concerns stage continuity across sites, and IDEA000566 concerns paths and intermediate mechanisms. This card does not claim novelty for site or causal roles. The possible added constraint is one named instrument kind in overlapping organs with differently configured instrumental roles; full predecessor review is still required. No raw predecessor body was reopened in this batch.
design.minimum_next_step: Review exact instrumental-role, stage/site and modifier predecessors first. If this distinction remains, author a complete admitted account with both configured roles and their explicit scopes. Do not build an executor while configuration, bearer or event role lives only in external commentary.
design.decision_changing_result: A written construction that preserves one instrument kind across two explicit configurations while its role relation changes could constrain a full hypothetical reading. If only unconnected organ/faculty names are supplied, this mechanism remains unchosen. An authored rule that derives inverse action solely from orientation is unsupported and must be rejected without repairing the source.
assumptions: One historical physiological account is a candidate content model, not established biological fact or an identified exemplar.
Kind/configuration/role are analytical distinctions; none is a discovered target segmentation.
